title: Bijectivity forced by the injective cocycle formula
statement: Under the abelian, enough-injectives, and derived-category assumptions [def-sp-abelian, def-sp-injective-resolutions, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], let $M$ be an object and $I$ a bounded below complex [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories] of injectives. Put $v=\operatorname{Hom}(M,-)$ [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. Fix $n\in\mathbf Z$. Any additive homomorphism $\beta:H^n(Rv(QI))\to\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(M[0],(QI)[n])$ whose value on every cocycle class transported through the inverse cohomology-to-Q isomorphism and the derived unit is the corresponding localized shifted map followed by the quotient-to-derived comparison is bijective. No natural family or resolution independence is assumed.

proof.text: Bounded below injectives are K-injective. Compose CohomologyClass.equivOfIsKInjective with SmallShiftedHom.equiv and postcomposition by the shifted quotient comparison; this gives a bijection E from Hom-complex cohomology classes to the derived Hom group. Its value on a cocycle is the required localized map.

The composite T from the concrete kernel of the differential of v(I), through cycles and the homology projection, the inverse cohomology-to-Q isomorphism, and the derived unit is surjective, because the projection is epi and the other arrows are isomorphisms. The normalization is beta(Tx)=E([x]). Surjectivity of E and of the single-source cocycle constructor gives surjectivity of beta. If beta(Tx)=beta(Ty), injectivity of E makes [x-y] zero. HomComplexSingle identifies x-y with a boundary g d; hence x-y is in the range subgroup of ShortComplex.abToCycles. The explicit homology quotient annihilates it, so T(x-y)=0 and Tx=Ty. This proves injectivity.

theorem rhom_injective_cocycle_map_bijective
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] [EnoughInjectives C]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} C] [HasDerivedCategory.{w₂} AddCommGrpCat.{v}] (M : C)
    (I : CochainComplex.Plus C)
    (_hi : ∀ k : ℤ, Injective (I.obj.X k)) (n : ℤ) :
    let V := preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (op M)
    let RV := V.rightDerivedFunctorPlus
    let H (n : ℤ) := DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{v} n
    let S := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj M
    ∀ β : (H n).obj (RV.obj ((DerivedCategory.Plus.Q (C := C)).obj I)) →+
        (S ⟶ ((DerivedCategory.Plus.Q (C := C)).obj I).obj⟦n⟧),
      (∀ (f : M ⟶ I.obj.X n) (hf : f ≫ I.obj.d n (n + 1) = 0),
        let J := (V.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I.obj
        let a := J.homologyπ n ((J.sc n).abCyclesIso.inv
          ⟨f, by
            change f ≫ I.obj.d n ((ComplexShape.up ℤ).next n) = 0
            rw [CochainComplex.next]
            exact hf⟩)
        let b := (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctorObjQIso
          (V.mapCochainComplexPlus.obj I) n).inv a
        let η := V.rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnit.app ((HomotopyCategory.Plus.quotient C).obj I)
        β ((H n).map η b) =
          ShiftedHom.map (Cocycle.equivHomShift.symm
              (Cocycle.fromSingleMk f (zero_add n) (n + 1) rfl hf)) DerivedCategory.Q ≫
            ((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso C).hom.app I.obj)⟦n⟧') → Function.Bijective β
